literal: In prosperity is needed humility; in small reduction is needed elevation.
translation: In times of prosperity, one needs humility. In times of decline, one needs to maintain high dignity.
modern: செல்வம் பெருகும் காலத்தில் பணிவு வேண்டும்; செல்வம் சுருங்கி வறுமை வரும் காலத்தில் தாழ்ந்து போகாத உயர்வான குணம் வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts how one should behave in good and bad times. During prosperity, a person should practice humility to avoid arrogance. Conversely, during a reduction in wealth or status, one must maintain elevation and dignity to avoid losing self-respect. True honor lies in balancing modesty when wealthy with unyielding self-worth when poor.
